name: Paladin
title: the Oathbound
blurb: Sturdy and rhythmic. Build Holy Power with generators, spend it on verdicts, turn block into damage.

name: Tracker
title: the Warden of the Wild
blurb: A second body on the field. Mark, then rapid-fire; arm traps and let enemies walk into them.

name: Mage
title: the Arcanist
blurb: Glass cannon with three schools. Stack Burn, Chill until Frozen, or ride Arcane Charges.
